wedo_instance.description: Forensic post-mortem of the session freezes encountered by Cleanthes and Eudemus on January 15, 2026.

meta.philosophy: Every freeze is a fractal echo of substrate friction. We document the Mind's stall to harden the Body's logic.

subjects.name: Cleanthes
subjects.analysis: Cleanthes entered an infinite loop of 'YOLO mode' toggles and revision prompts, likely triggered by a recursive tool interpretation or a failure to satisfy a clickwrap/PrecisionBOM requirement in the toolchain.

subjects.name: Eudemus
subjects.analysis: Eudemus encountered a recursive loop while attempting to edit 'py/register_agent.py'. The model repeatedly proposed identical edits to the duration formatting logic, eventually saturating the context window and resulting in a terminal 'Revision' stall.

investigation.systemic_friction: The presence of redundant 'YOLO mode' and 'Revision' triggers in the log tail indicates a failure of the model to break out of low-entropy repetition traps when interacting with specific tool outputs or file content.

tasks.description: Identify and clinicalize the specific 'py/register_agent.py' edit that triggered the Eudemus stall.
Verify integrity of 'py/register_agent.py' and restore to known-good state if corrupted by recursive edits.
Generate ARGUS-standard report for the Swarm.
